{{Quote|Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on the forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|[[Ketu]], of the non&ndash;Force-sensitive Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Ska Gora''' was a verdant [[Tree/Legends|forest]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. More than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] colonized Ska Gora. Most of the planet's population lived in [[City-ship/Legends|city-ships]] that floated above Ska Gora's surface, but when the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Gharcanna]] led members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] to illegally settle the surface, the matter ended in a [[Wookiee land wars|conflict]] that saw the illegal settlers [[Death/Legends|dead]] and swaths of the [[apex tree]] forests ablaze.

==Description==
[[File:Ska_Gora_City_Ship.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The floating [[City-ship/Legends|city-ships]] where most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] population resided]]
Ska Gora was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a single [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at grid coordinates L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet occupied the eighth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]]. A temperate and verdant world home to enormous [[apex tree]]s, Ska Gora had its surface covered with huge regions of forests, [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]], and wetlands. It also featured an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with white-colored clouds and at least one [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region. Nearly all of the planet's population, which numbered in at least the tens of thousands, lived in [[City-ship/Legends|city-ships]] that floated above Ska Gora's surface in order to protect the world's wilderness.<ref name="DotJ0" /> Vicious winds occasionally crossed the planet's surface, stirring the jungles, and many of the planet's trees were thousands of years old by [[25,793 BBY]]. However, the planet also featured deep [[Mine/Legends|mines]] that produced precious stones and metals (the silver from which Lanoree Brock's silver bracelets were made).<ref name="Into the Void" />

==History==
{{Dialogue|Xiang|And your defusing of the Wookiee land wars on Ska Gora probably prevented a civil war.|Lanoree Brock|It was hardly a defusing.|Lha-Mi|The deaths were unfortunate, but they prevented countless more.|Xiang|You saved tens of thousands. Maybe more. The Wookiee warlord Gharcanna had to be stopped.|attr=Xiang, Lanoree Brock, and Lha-Mi|src=<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
More than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Into the Void" /> when the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" /> the fifth planet of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" /> [[Second migration|traveled]] to Tython's neighboring worlds, they colonized Ska Gora.<ref name="DotJ1" /> In [[25,800 BBY]], the [[Je'daii Order|Je'daii]] [[Daegen Lok]] experienced a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] of an [[Army/Legends|army]] of dark warriors wielding [[Forcesaber|blades of fire]], marching across the burning surface of Ska Gora as the city-ships fell to ground.<ref name="DotJ7">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref>

Sometime between [[25,797 BBY]] and 25,793 BBY, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Gharcanna]] led members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] in illegally settling Ska Gora's surface, despite the restrictions against doing so. The [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] was dispatched by the [[Je'daii Council]] to Ska Gora,<ref name="Into the Void" /> where she stayed with a family of Wookiees<ref name="Eruption">{{InsiderCite|141|Eruption}}</ref> and tried all diplomatic methods available to get the Wookiees to depart the surface. However, Gharcanna refused to back down, and Brock was eventually forced to fire upon the forests and kill the Wookiees who were on the planet's surface. The attack destroyed swaths of the forests, but the [[Wookiee land wars]], as they became known, were necessary to prevent a civil war between the Wookiees and the other settlers of Ska Gora.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ska Gora was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planet was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Ska Gora's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].
